diagnostics.message: aws_ecs_cluster_capacity_providers.this associates capacity providers with the cluster by name, including the autoscaling capacity providers created by aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this (their names come from var.autoscaling_capacity_providers). AWS requires the capacity provider to exist before it can be associated with a cluster (and to be detached before deletion), but no implicit or explicit dependency on aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this is recorded — the only reference to those resources is inside the nested dynamic \"default_capacity_provider_strategy\" block and is not captured as a dependency. Without this ordering, the association can be applied before the capacity providers are created and fail. Add a depends_on, or better, build the autoscaling portion of the capacity_providers set from the created resources' name attributes (identical values: try(each.value.name, each.key)), which establishes the ordering as a data dependency.

fix.expression:
distinct(concat(
    [for k, v in var.fargate_capacity_providers : try(v.name, k)],
    [for k, v in aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this : v.name]
  ))
